title: Penthouse October 1974 Pet of the Year Complete w/ Centerfold Lucky Luciano
condition_description: Vintage 1974 issue. Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge and corner wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
description:
Penthouse magazine, October 1974 - Pet of the Year issue, original $1.25 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: Pet of the Year; Gasoline Crisis: The Old Shell Game?; Is Gerald Ford an Eagle Scout?; The Lucky Luciano Confessions, Part II; Sam Posey: The Getty of Grand Prix Racing; Prisoners of War: The Long Road Back.

Back cover: Tareyton 100's cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
